articles.title: Will the Nationwide Ground Stop Affect Your Thanksgiving Travel Plans?
articles.summary: Nearly 6 million people are expected to fly within the U.S. over the Thanksgiving holiday, just a little more than a week after a telecommunications issue prompted the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to order a nationwide ground stop that continued to disrupt flights around the country even days after it ended. articles.title: Democrats Now Have the Power to Nullify the Electoral College. Here’s How
articles.summary: After flipping several key state legislatures and gubernatorial seats in this month’s elections , Democrats now have a path to nullify an institution of U.S. elections that has cost the party at least two presidential contests so far this century: the Electoral College. articles.title: The U.S. Has Lost Its Measles-Elimination Status. Here’s What That Means
articles.summary: For more than a quarter of a century, the U.S. has held measles-elimination status, meaning the virus was no longer spreading continuously within the country. Prior to the introduction of the first measles vaccine in 1963, nearly all American children contracted the disease before they were 15, for an annual case count of up to four million, including 400 to 500 deaths and 48,000 hospitalizations. articles.title: What to Know About the Apple Outage
articles.summary: Apple has resolved outages that impacted several of the company's services on Tuesday, including Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple Support. Thousands of users had reported experiencing issues with multiple Apple platforms beginning Tuesday morning. Apple attributed the problems to an internal update and said that it was in the process of addressing them as of the afternoon. articles.title: What Is the Kerch Bridge—and Why Does Ukraine Keep Attacking It?
articles.summary: An overnight Ukrainian missile attack has severely damaged the vital Kerch bridge linking occupied Crimea with Russia, delivering a symbolic blow to Russian President Vladimir Putin ahead of a summit in Asia where he is expected to meet President Donald Trump . The road and rail bridge was built after Russia invaded and annexed the Crimean peninsula in 2014 and connects Crimea to Russia's southern Krasnodar region.
